items.prompt: Resolve additional ciliary centrin arm and hook-complex proteins before expanding the component list.
items.rationale: The ciliary centrin arm is a Centrin4-containing complex, but this first record does not assert BOH1 or other hook-complex proteins as arm constituents until source-neutral families and their structural boundaries are curated.

items.prompt: Resolve SanaTA native host breadth, SanaA/SanaT molecular activities, T7 Gp4.5/Lon anti-defense logic, and the SanaTA__SanaT_1 profile before minting narrower SanaTA mechanism children.
items.rationale: Sberro et al. support sanaTA as a Shewanella sp. ANA-3 two-gene toxin-antitoxin family that confers resistance to T7 phage mutants lacking gene 4.5 when expressed in Escherichia coli, and DefenseFinder models SanaTA with SanaTA__SanaA and SanaTA__SanaT. This first system-level record leaves the natural host range, SanaA/SanaT activities, T7 Gp4.5/Lon counter-defense sequence, and the extra non-rule SanaTA__SanaT_1 HMM unresolved.

items.prompt: Add strain-matched UniProtKB protein_examples for Ideonella dechloratans chlorate reductase (ClrABC) and chlorite dismutase (Cld) so chlorate_respiration_pathway_sketch can be promoted from NONMECHANISTIC to MECHANISTIC.
items.rationale: The record's primary literature (DOI:10.1128/AEM.69.9.5585-5592.2003, DOI:10.1128/AEM.07303-11) supports the two-step dissimilatory chlorate reduction pathway (chlorate reduction followed by chlorite decomposition) in Ideonella dechloratans (NCBITaxon:36863), but verified UniProtKB accessions must be added to a GENE_OR_PROTEIN node before marking the graph MECHANISTIC.

attaches_to: ecological_interactions#Core Floodplain Aerobic and Sulfur Oxidation Capacity
items.prompt: Which genomes and environmental mechanisms link conserved capacity to measured flux?
items.rationale: Core capacity enrichment is a part/whole description, not a causal consequence requiring an arrow. Gene inventories did not predict one-time expression, and the 2016 RNA study sampled only L. Direct flux and selective environmental perturbations are missing. The canonical Nitrospira genus ID cannot stand in for the paper's Nitrospirae phylum; Acidobacteriota are non-core and overall more transcriptionally active at higher organic carbon. Neither is assigned an unsupported graph link just to suppress disconnected warnings. Taxonomy and non-graph scope remain under #1421; no GTDB withholding policy is changed.

attaches_to: ecological_interactions#PTS-Mediated Glucose Specialization, CCR-Driven Xylose Exclusion, and Homofermentative D-Lactate Production by E. coli GL10 Monoculture
items.prompt: Why does E. coli GL10 convert 5 g/L sole xylose into only 0.64 g/L D-lactate (0.018 g/L/h) despite exhibiting growth and xylose consumption rates nearly identical to wild-type E. coli?
items.rationale: In sole-xylose medium, GL10 exhibited growth and xylose consumption kinetics nearly identical to WT (Fig. 5A) but yielded 3.92-fold lower D-lactate conversion (0.64 g/L) than on sole glucose (3.15 g/L), whereas deleting ptsI and glk in the same eight-gene knockout background (strain XL12) increased sole-xylose D-lactate to 2.66 g/L (53.2% conversion).
items.record_label: Escherichia coli GL10 Glucose-Specialized D-Lactate Isolate Baseline

items.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral component groundings for reaction-center L/M/H, LH1 alpha/beta, and PufX families before adding subunit-level component rows.
items.rationale: The complete RC-LH1-PufX core is a record-level chromatophore complex here, but its first record does not guess which InterPro, Pfam or NCBIfam terms exactly cover the purple-bacterial reaction-center, LH1, and PufX constituents.

items.prompt: Should a phospholipid monolayer be curated as a PHA granule component?
items.rationale: GO:0070088 still mentions a phospholipid monolayer from the older structural model, but Bresan et al. 2016 reported that purified PHA granules contain PHA and protein and no detectable phospholipids, so the monolayer is deliberately not curated as a component. Correction (2026-10-16): the earlier experiment description above was inaccurate. Bresan et al. used phospholipid-binding fluorescent probes in vivo; rare labeling of isolated granules was attributed to contamination, not a bulk chemical composition measurement. The native-producer results and recombinant E. coli observations must be distinguished.

items.prompt: Which primary experimental constructs and intervening steps can be independently verified for the altemicidin Sbz pathway?
items.rationale: The 2019 article request returned HTTP429, the 2021 publisher preview is subscription-only, and the 2024 SbzI article redirected to an inaccessible authentication endpoint. No alternate article retrieval was attempted. Functions here are adopted UniProt database assertions, not independently inspected primary experiments; genomic and GenPept records support native reference identity only.

items.prompt: Keep actinophryid extrusomes distinct from ciliate extrusomes and context-specific vacuole terms.
items.rationale: The source distinguishes amorphous actinophryid contents from organized ciliate extrusomes; toxicyst is not adopted as an exact synonym. GO:0043231 is the broader parent; GO:0030141 additionally assumes Golgi origin, not established here. The prey-vacuole membrane node remains ungrounded because GO:0020020 denotes a parasite vacuole digesting host cytoplasm.

items.prompt: Resolve whether a source-neutral SO identifier exactly denotes the diploid germline chromosomal DNA of ciliate micronuclei.
items.rationale: Micronuclear chromosomal DNA is the germline DNA carried inside a ciliate micronucleus. Generic GO chromosome terms describe complete chromosomal structures rather than this ciliate-specific DNA constituent.

items.prompt: Resolve whether a source-neutral SO identifier exactly denotes the processed, amplified chromosomal DNA of ciliate macronuclei.
items.rationale: Macronuclear chromosomal DNA is processed and amplified on the chromosomes of a ciliate somatic nucleus. Generic GO chromosome terms describe complete chromosomal structures rather than this ciliate-specific DNA constituent.

items.prompt: Which T4 enzymes and members causally mediate parent-compound removal, and what transformation products and fitness effects result?
items.rationale: The complete primary body supports positive HPLC parent-removal outcomes, growth and redox proxies, and post-assay predicted pathway coverage. It does not experimentally assign the predicted enzyme activities or intermediary flux to T4 strains. Selective member/enzyme perturbations, product identification and mass balance would test mediation and distinguish removal from mineralization or detoxification. Reciprocal fitness benefits and the suggested reduced consortium remain untested. The former prediction-to-removal workflow arrow is not restored. Salinity and temperature inconsistencies in non-graph metadata remain in #1371.

items.prompt: Add primary microbial literature evidence for glutamyl aminopeptidase (EC 3.4.11.7) catalysis and N-terminal dicarboxylic amino-acid cleavage before constructing causal_graphs.
items.rationale: The current record carries two diagnostic enzyme-panel survey snippets (DOI:10.1099/ijsem.0.006017, DOI:10.1099/ijs.0.63642-0) without verbatim catalytic reaction or enzyme-mechanism quotes.

items.prompt: Avoid bilayer-only wording for the taxon-spanning plasma membrane record.
items.rationale: Bacterial and fungal plasma membranes are bilayers built largely from ester-linked lipids, whereas archaeal cytoplasmic membranes use ether lipids and can be diether bilayers or tetraether monolayers. This broad record therefore uses lipid-boundary wording and leaves exact lipid topology to lineage-specific records.

items.prompt: Keep the Schizosaccharomyces Isp3 layer separate from the Saccharomyces chitosan and dityrosine-rich ascospore-wall layers.
items.rationale: GO:1990916 denotes the Schizosaccharomyces pombe Isp3 layer, whereas GO:0005631 and GO:0005630 denote Saccharomyces chitosan and dityrosine spore-wall layers.

items.prompt: Keep coordinated group feeding distinct from claims of obligatory cooperation.
items.rationale: Predatory bacterium traitmech:000054 supplies killing and nutrition; coordinated multicellular predation supplies the differentia. Mere cell density, aggregation, motility or prey lysis without feeding is insufficient. This is a capability expressed by cells in a group context, not a claim that a lone cell displays a collective phenotype. It does not require every cell to attack one prey simultaneously or benefit equally. Solitary killing and collective feeding can coexist in the same organism; no obligate group dependence or disjointness is asserted. Cooperative predation and wolf-pack predation are not assigned exact synonym status: cooperation in an evolutionary fitness sense requires separate evidence. The 2023 scout/loner/swarm bins are analysis states, not distinct primary traits. Swarming motility traitmech:000062 is explicitly flagella-dependent; gliding METPO:1000706 and twitching traitmech:000061 do not require predation. Epibiotic, periplasmic and cytoplasmic predation classify predator location, not group organization. No exact xrefs or synonyms are assigned.

attaches_to: ecological_interactions#Proposed Acetate Oxidation and Interspecies Electron Transfer
items.prompt: Is the G. sulfurreducens-induced metabolic shift in C. pasteurianum actually caused by contact-dependent direct interspecies electron transfer along conductive pili, or by a diffusible mediator (candidate: a cobamide) released by G. sulfurreducens?
items.rationale: The prior contact-dependent DIET assertion was withdrawn in #256/#262; #295 corrected a remaining generic-background citation. This review also qualifies the broader IET interpretation: qPCR growth and an assumed electron balance do not directly measure uptake or selectively prove its mediation of the product shift. The 2017 Discussion proposes, rather than measures, nanowire-rich/planktonic inoculum heterogeneity and suggests conductive biofilms as future work. The record name and filename already use interspecies electron transfer rather than DIET, so the former pending-rename note is obsolete. The 2022 abstract describes mediated interaction and a putative cobamide model, with possible electron entry as reinforcement. Its full body remains inaccessible subscription content; the previously reported 0.22-um-filtered spent-medium result was not verified here and is not evidence for these graph decisions. Neither contact-dependent wiring, cobamide transfer nor a particular entry protein is asserted as established. Non-graph environmental, ingredient and overview text is preserved by this graph-scoped repair and is not scientifically certified by it.

items.prompt: Review dispersal hierarchy without equating formation and discharge.
items.rationale: Use phenotype METPO:1000059. The sporulation and spore-forming records METPO:1000870 and METPO:1000871 concern endospores. Discharge is also distinct from passive shedding, later wind transport and pressure-driven ascospore or sporangium ejection. Motility METPO:1000701 emphasizes independent locomotion; a closer dispersal parent and process-versus-phenotype mappings need review. Ballistospore and ballistoconidium name cells, not exact synonyms of this disposition; no exact synonyms or xrefs are asserted. Do not require a particular speed, distance, fruiting body or asexual developmental mode.

items.prompt: Keep mineral formation distinct from association and process-level mappings.
items.rationale: The definition includes controlled, induced and matrix-mediated formation when microbial mediation is demonstrated; it is not restricted to carbonate, intracellular deposition or a crystalline end product. Benzerara et al. DOI:10.1016/j.crte.2010.09.002 section 2 includes passive organic-matter effects under biologically influenced biomineralization. This broad terminology is retained, but precipitation near a cell, isolated nonliving-matrix activity, mineral adhesion, uptake of preformed particles or ion adsorption alone does not establish that organism's formation phenotype. Organic-substrate mineralization, mineral dissolution, metal tolerance and mineral use as an electron donor are not equivalent. Coccolith and siliceous-scale production are narrower endpoints. Magnetosome and ferrosome organelle records retain their structural parents; no automatic cross-axis reparenting or disjointness is asserted. The magnetosome graph's similarly named node has narrower scope and is not exactly grounded to this umbrella. No synonyms or xrefs are asserted pending authority-backed phenotype mapping.

items.prompt: Which SynCom members directly drive the Ralstonia solanacearum density drop in calcium-conditioned tomato root exudate, and is suppression mediated by antibiotic antagonism, calcium/root-metabolite competition, or both?
items.rationale: Bi et al. showed that all four isolates antagonized Ralstonia solanacearum and that the SynCom plus calcium-conditioned tomato root exudates reduced Ralstonia density. The paper also reports pairwise plate assays and predicted plant-growth-promoting genes, but it did not resolve member-to-member metabolic exchange or show which SynCom strain directly caused the Ralstonia drop in root-exudate co-culture. Barcode-tracked single, triple-dropout, and full four-member SynComs in the 20 mM calcium-conditioned root-exudate assay would resolve the member-level contributions.

items.prompt: Establish exact taxon-neutral family groundings for the RhlB and aconitase client classes.
items.rationale: The verified strain-specific UniProt mappings identify the assayed loci, but domain and broad superfamily matches cannot substitute for exact whole-protein family groundings. Current UniProt calls CCNA_01923 RhpA, whereas the paper and gene symbol call it RhlB; this nomenclature difference is explicitly retained.

items.prompt: How should complementary substrate accessibility connect to panel-level degradation without overstating partner benefit?
items.rationale: Full public primary main body and Methods read. Cell-free residual substrate and six active purified enzymes support complementary accessibility; no universal contact requirement, small-molecule exchange or reciprocal benefit follows. Depletion combines cleavage and uptake, not CO2 mineralization. Preserve the five-member maximum, G88 exclusion, variable total inoculum and experimental/model distinction. The Results describe fitting one-, two- and three-member communities while Methods more generally reference the 127-community data; code and raw data were not audited, so no independent train/test verification is claimed. New structure is pending #1465 after the one-community Edison dry run; specific credit authorization requested, no job or spend. Two corrected existing nodes and zero arrows are not a completed causal expansion. Figure images and original supplements were not inspected.

items.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings and component boundaries for Fez proteins in characterized ferrosome systems.

attaches_to: ecological_interactions#Inorganic-Donor Oxidation to Volatile Fatty Acids
items.prompt: Which exact donor-derived metabolites and taxa mediate Cr(VI) reduction in each enrichment?

Literature acetate-fed comparator rows in SI Table S2 are not measurements in this system. Exact membership, VFA identity, biological versus abiotic contributions over time and deposited-species stability require full-system evidence. items.rationale: During curation, BioRxiv Highwire Table 1 and supplementary material endpoints returned HTTP 429 rate-limit responses. The final composition was reconstructed from paper-linked GitHub source spreadsheets, analysis code, and NCBI BioSample records.

items.prompt: Preserve the complete reproductive capability rather than an isolated readout.
items.rationale: The record denotes an organismal phenotype, not a locus, protein, ploidy measurement or individual mating experiment. Nuclear fusion followed by nonmeiotic chromosome loss permits genetic reassortment; mating can be part of this cycle. Do not define parasexuality as absence of all mating, sexual programs or meiosis-associated genes. It does not require haploid progeny, obligate asexuality, identical ploidy in every product or successful cycling in every isolate. Hyphal fusion, heterokaryosis, marker loss, aneuploidy, ploidy change and horizontal gene transfer alone are insufficient. The existing ploidy trait describes genome-copy number, not this capability. Ploidy and hyphal anastomosis are not is-a parents. The fungal scope reflects the cited evidence; broader uses of parasexual terminology require separate interpretation. Resolve external phenotype/process mappings and exact synonyms at their authorities before adding them.

items.prompt: What evidence, if any, resolves a biological mechanism behind the statistical phenotype?
items.rationale: The eLife study quantified functional effects and interaction coefficients from Abs600 phenotypes, but did not identify the molecular mechanism behind the positive third-order interaction in the high-Abs600 trio.

items.prompt: Resolve modern strain identities and native protein anchors before enrichment.
items.rationale: Canonical examples await modern NCBI identity and original strain-provenance checks, especially for historical Glomus names and E2368. The 2012 soft perturbation/rescue supports a native candidate mechanism but is not a universal dependency. Read its supplements and resolve taxon-paired protein accessions before adding causal nodes. Do not infer a ligand/receptor chain from approach or use NONMECHANISTIC to bypass missing protein grounding.

items.prompt: Which strain- and condition-specific interactions explain growth and persistence in this dyad?
items.rationale: The source combines batch, continuous, density-dependent and production assays. Keep their positive results without treating every partner or strain as persistent for weeks to months. Cyanobacterial growth stimulation is observed, but metabolite return and byproduct absorption remain hypotheses. Light-associated inhibition is supported without identifying oxygen as the exclusive cause. For Bacillus, the canonical168 production assay is distinct from 3610 perturbation experiments. For E. coli, the early non-sucrose inference differs from later sucrose-sensitive production; for yeast, W303Clump is not parental W303. No new causal node, direction, cultivation protocol or strain optimization is added.

items.rationale: Patel et al. support Tab as a prophage-encoded anti-phage defence protein that blocks invading phage-tail assembly and prevents release of infectious phage progeny, while the pinned DefenseFinder article registry names a Tab system. The pinned DefenseFinder HMM inventory and rules table have no Tab rows, and the evidence does not yet resolve host breadth, target-phage breadth, counter-defence specificity, or profile-to-activity modeling.

items.prompt: Resolve Lamassu subtype architecture, effector diversity, and viral-DNA trigger specificity before minting narrower Lamassu mechanism children.
items.rationale: Haudiquet et al. support a structurally characterized Vibrio cholerae Lamassu Vc-Cap4 system with LmuABC DNA-end sensing and LmuA Cap4 nuclease activation, and the pinned DefenseFinder tables model Lamassu-Amidase, Lamassu-Cap4_nuclease, Lamassu-FMO, Lamassu-Hydrolase, Lamassu-Lipase, Lamassu-Mrr, Lamassu-PDDEXK, Lamassu-Protease, Lamassu-Sir2, and other Lamassu-Fam subtypes as rule-row variants. Lamassu-Amidase, Lamassu-Cap4 nuclease, Lamassu-FMO, Lamassu-Hydrolase, Lamassu-Lipase, Lamassu-Mrr, Lamassu-PDDEXK, Lamassu-Protease, and Lamassu-Sir2 now capture nine DefenseFinder rule-row subtypes, but long-versus-short LmuB clades, LmuC-independent subfamilies, the Lamassu-Fam base, Lamassu-Hydrolase_Protease, and Lamassu-Hypothetical rule rows, viral-DNA triggers, exact LmuA effector substrates, FMO acronym expansion, the Lamassu-FMO rule row's relationship to FMO-scoped LmuB/LmuC HMM rows, the Lamassu-Lipase rule row's relationship to its Lipase-scoped LmuB HMM row, the Lamassu-Mrr rule row's relationship to Mrr-scoped LmuB/LmuC HMM rows, the Lamassu-PDDEXK rule row's relationship to PDDEXK-scoped LmuB/LmuC HMM rows, the Lamassu-Sir2 rule row's relationship to Sir2-scoped LmuB/LmuC HMM rows, and cell-death outputs across Lamassu loci remain unresolved. Lamassu Hydrolase-Protease system (traitmech:000567) now captures the literature-supported paired architecture with LmuB and LmuC. Its pinned executable XML requires four components, whereas the summary TSV requires three matches and calls LmuC accessory. The existing table-defined Lamassu-Hydrolase and Lamassu-Protease siblings each forbid the other's effector profile and are not exact matches to this paired architecture. Reconciling the legacy table-based sibling definitions with executable models remains open; do not interpret the summary's profile labels as current executable model requirements. Lamassu-HNH system (traitmech:000568) now captures the literature-supported short-LmuB architecture with HNH-domain LmuA and LmuC. The published dataset supplies complete computational genome calls, not HNH-specific functional validation. The pinned executable HNH model accepts either long or short LmuB, whereas all HNH calls in that dataset use short LmuB; its software key is therefore not an exact synonym for this biological scope. HNH-specific activity, substrates, and activation remain unresolved. Lamassu-SMEK system (traitmech:000569) now captures a locus with SMEK-domain LmuA, LmuB, and LmuC. The paper describes SMEK as short-specific, but its dataset contains 124 short-profile system calls and one long-profile call; the latter requires reconciliation before asserting a biological long-LmuB subtype. The definition therefore does not impose a LmuB-length restriction. The three-component architecture is not equivalent to the single-gene DS-27 system that also uses SMEK as a working label. SMEK-specific functional validation and chemistry remain unresolved. Short Lamassu system (traitmech:000570) now captures the short-LmuB phylogenetic and structural family, not a fixed protein-length bin or an effector-specific detector. Lamassu-HNH is placed below it because its existing definition explicitly requires short-form LmuB. SMEK remains directly under the broader Lamassu parent because of its unresolved long-profile exception. The short family permits the reported LmuC-loss and effector-domain-loss architectures; type I is not an exact synonym for the whole short family. The Lamassu-Hypothetical registry label is not accepted as a separate biological trait here: unknown annotation does not establish effector-domain loss, and its relationship to the paper's clade O still needs explicit mapping. The long family and component-number subtypes remain separate discovery leads. Long Lamassu system (traitmech:000571) now captures the complementary long-LmuB phylogenetic and structural family, not an 800-residue cutoff or a particular effector model. The paper assigns the B. cereus B4077 Hydrolase-Protease system to this family, but that effector architecture also occurs in short Lamassu, so the whole Hydrolase-Protease trait is not reparented. The legacy table-defined FMO trait still needs model and biological-scope reconciliation before assigning the entire record to the long family. SMEK's exception remains unresolved. Raw detection gene_name hits must not be confused with exchangeable hit_gene_ref model slots, and ambiguous loci need phylogenetic classification. Component-number type I/II traits remain separate discovery leads. Lamassu type II system (traitmech:000572) now captures the LmuC-containing component architecture defined by Payne et al. (DOI:10.1093/nar/gkab883) and independently used by Li et al. (DOI:10.1038/s41589-025-02102-z). HNH, SMEK and Hydrolase-Protease already require LmuC in their definitions and now have this parent; HNH retains its short-family parent too. This does not assert a three-gene count, universal LmuC essentiality, or new antiviral validation of those children. Long/short families and legacy detector rows are not equivalent to this component class. Type I and family-wide mechanisms remain open discovery and curation questions. Lamassu type I system (traitmech:000573) now resolves the component-class discovery lead: Haudiquet et al. explicitly identify the LmuC-loss architecture as type I, and Li et al. independently study a type-I LmuA/LmuB complex. This is not equivalent to all short Lamassu or proof that every failed LmuC hit is biological absence. No existing effector-defined child is reparented. Family-wide mechanisms, legacy model reconciliation and native-host activity remain open.

GO:0140504 (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/ontology/go/terms/GO%3A0140504) separately denotes microlipophagy. Both are nonobsolete biological processes, not exact organismal-phenotype xrefs. Preserve this source-attributed scope difference for human review; no universal macro/micro route, selectivity mechanism, starvation trigger or ATG inventory is asserted. Lipolysis traitmech:000190 concerns triacylglycerol hydrolysis: it can overlap lipophagy but is neither an exact synonym nor a necessary broader parent for all droplet cargo. Lipid storage, PHA granules and pigment sequestration are not equivalent degradation phenotypes. No exact synonyms or mappings are added.

Direct DMSP release/consumption flux, individual nutrient rescue and mediator-specific perturbations remain unresolved; carbon-only supplementation was negative. items.prompt: The recorded compound 3 structure is proposed, not definitively elucidated. What direct structural evidence establishes its connectivity and stereochemistry?

The imported molecular graph is retained as that proposal; stereo_complete: false alone does not express the constitutional uncertainty.

items.prompt: Resolve type-I partner functions and reconcile incomplete detector calls.

Conversely, DefenseFinder's three-match threshold does not establish a complete locus. Missing profiles, incomplete assemblies and engineered deletions do not by themselves establish natural component absence or a new subtype. Full locus context is required, and a genome may encode several Druantia subtypes. The specific functions of type-I partners, the phage trigger, native-host activity and defense breadth remain open. The first TraitRecord therefore stays at the broad PARIS-system level until separate subtype review resolves which foreign-protein triggers, AriB activities, and anti-defense suppressors apply across each PARIS family.

items.prompt: This record routes two independent paths to immune evasion -- complement-regulator binding by surface proteins, and effector delivery through the T3SS. In a given host, is either route sufficient on its own, or does established infection require both?
items.rationale: The graph draws both arrows into the same node without saying whether they are alternatives or partners. If either is sufficient, single-target antivirulence strategies are viable; if evasion needs both, only combination approaches will work, and the two edges should carry that dependency rather than reading as parallel routes.

items.prompt: Resolve broader biomineralization placement without conflating endpoints.
items.rationale: Use phenotype METPO:1000059 pending a source-backed broader biomineralization phenotype. This is production of scales, not mere possession, acquisition or reuse of preformed scales, their extrusion, or their arrangement into a shell or scale layer. It is not equivalent to general silicification, diatom frustule formation, magnetosome or ferrosome possession, substrate adhesion, or growth on a particular chemical. These neighboring endpoints do not alone demonstrate new-scale production. Do not infer a universal scale geometry, covering architecture, cell-cycle coupling or fitness effect. No exact synonyms, xrefs, homology or organism-level disjointness are asserted.

items.prompt: Which R2A exchanges occur in culture, and what explains coexistence despite agar antagonism?
items.rationale: The three-member R2A model contains YR343, GM17 and AP49; CF313 belongs to the four-member MOPS model. items.prompt: Preserve persistence after stress removal and the resistance endpoint.
items.rationale: Compare matched genetic backgrounds and challenge conditions after removal of the inducing stress. Persistent resistance is not merely faster transcriptional reactivation or faster reacquisition after a second induction. A marker, aggregate, gene, ongoing stress response or single survival measurement alone does not establish this history-dependent phenotype. Cell-level or lineage-restricted protection need not improve population-average survival. No fixed duration, number of divisions, stressor identity or molecular mechanism is required. Genetic adaptation, carbon-source memory, cue-triggered anticipation, diversifying bet hedging, persister formation and unequal aggregate inheritance are not equivalent, though particular observations can overlap. Unqualified cellular memory, stress priming and cross-protection are not asserted as exact synonyms. Stress response (traitmech:000078) concerns sensing and mounting protection; its research report includes cross-protection as an output but does not establish persistence after removal. METPO:1000059 phenotype is the conservative parent pending hierarchy review; existing records are unchanged.

items.prompt: Reconcile model-summary drift and resolve paired effector chemistry.

The single-effector table-defined siblings are not asserted to be parents or equivalents of this paired system. The direct parent is now traitmech:000572 Lamassu type II system because the biological definition already includes LmuC. The paired effector architecture illustrates why type II is not restricted to exactly three genes. This refinement does not resolve the legacy detector-summary drift or assign the whole trait to one LmuB-length family.

Fungal arbuscule formation traitmech:000664 concerns branched intracellular structures; hyphal anastomosis traitmech:000605 is fusion, pseudohyphal growth traitmech:000653 budding-cell chains, and haustorium formation traitmech:000663 a specialized host interface. items.prompt: Reconcile feeding-mode terminology with operational trait boundaries.

The 2023 Discussion calls myzocytosis a form of apical phagotrophy and endocytosis while arguing against phagocytosis and trogocytosis in its studied system. The 2012 Introduction uses phagocytise for feeding-tube uptake; the 2024 study contrasts myzocytosis with conventional whole-prey phagocytosis. Those usages are not silently treated as identical. Local phagocytosis traitmech:000627 requires particle enclosure and internalization; phagotrophy traitmech:000628 requires particulate ingestion and nutrient assimilation. Retain phenotype METPO:1000059 pending a closer feeding-mode hierarchy rather than assert unsupported universal subtyping. Mere attachment, free-particle uptake, extracellular digestion or an apparatus-like sequence does not establish prey-content aspiration. A microbe may use several feeding modes; these possession traits are not declared disjoint. No unverified synonym or xref is asserted. Bulk hexamine, formaldehyde, and COD reduction in nutrient-containing AS broth (1% tryptone, 0.5% yeast extract, 50 mg/L hexamine) do not establish complete mineralization, strain-resolved substrate flux, or post-inoculation persistence of every assembled isolate, and Table 2 reports ammonia production rather than consortium ammonia removal.

items.prompt: Resolve NixI satellite self-protection, optional Stix profile scope, natural-host protein accessions, and divergent-homolog activity before minting narrower NixI mechanism children.
items.rationale: LeGault et al. support NixI as a PLE-encoded nicking endonuclease that cleaves ICP1 DNA and inhibits ICP1 genome replication, and DefenseFinder models NixI with a required NixI__NixI profile plus optional NixI__Stix. This first system-level record leaves the exact PLE self-protection mechanism, the optional Stix profile's experimental scope, the accession-level PLE1 NixI protein, the breadth of divergent homolog activity, and additional PLE anti-ICP1 mechanisms unresolved.

items.prompt: Recheck whether DefenseFinder adds a PD-T7-4 List_system_article.md row before using the article registry as direct PD-T7-4 model-to-paper evidence.

The PD-T7-4 record therefore cites the pinned wiki plus the DOI-backed Vassallo et al. screen instead of inventing a missing article-registry entry.

items.prompt: Distinguish observed behavior from model ablations and molecular hypotheses.
items.rationale: Son's computational removal of functional blocks is not a gene-knockout experiment. Gao's Na+-NQR explanation is explicitly hypothetical, with further experimental work requested. A mechanistic graph is deferred pending source-backed causal edges and eligible taxon-paired protein examples. Do not borrow the enterobacterial Che pathway from chemotaxis, infer causality from transcript changes, or use NONMECHANISTIC to bypass the protein-coverage requirement. No universal receptor is asserted.

items.prompt: Separate bundle composition from its nucleation site and attached chromosomal assemblies.
items.rationale: The SPB nucleates the array but is not its containing structure. Tub4/Spc97/Spc72 mark the nucleation site. All six kinetochore subcomplexes have array-associated localization in 2013; Dad2 and Nuf2 mark attachments in 2024. These are retained as interacting chromosome-bound machinery rather than asserted stoichiometric building blocks of the microtubule bundle. Centromeric Cse4/chromosomes and the displaced nucleolus are likewise not bundle components. Slk19 is included because its own direct bundle-end localization and perturbation are documented.

Registry names/MeSH associations are name-based and are not independent chemical certification. Exact PubChem graph agreement is verified; deleting its xref alone would not repair the biological assignment. The confirmed defect is unsupported exact-product assignment across the recorded contexts, not an experimentally established replacement structure. items.prompt: Resolve strain provenance and preserve source-access limits before adding canonical taxa.

Publisher DOI requests failed in the follow-up, some PMC requests returned challenge pages, and the 2003 PubMed page yielded no usable text. items.prompt: Retain a behavioral endpoint and distinguish neighboring uses of adaptation.
items.rationale: Repeated-stimulus decrement alone is insufficient: evaluate sensory adaptation, motor fatigue, injury/toxicity, selection and depletion alternatives in the actual assay. Specificity and recovery provide operational support without identifying all underlying mechanisms. Rankin 2009 frames habituation in neural behavioral terms; Rajan 2025 distinguishes that usage from cellular adaptation while modeling related receptor dynamics. This record concerns microbial behavior, not a categorical ban on shared molecular machinery. No fixed time, curve, complete recovery, dishabituation or all ten hallmarks are required in every experiment. Response to a stronger stimulus is not itself dishabituation. Carbon-source memory (traitmech:000706), acquired stress-resistance memory (traitmech:000712), enhanced transcriptional reactivation memory (traitmech:000713), anticipation, bet hedging and nutrient adaptation have distinct endpoints. Chemotaxis is not a parent of every behavioral assay. METPO:1000059 phenotype is the conservative parent; generic learning, memory and adaptation are not asserted as exact synonyms.

items.prompt: Keep bulk-fluid uptake distinct from neighboring uptake traits.
items.rationale: Retain phenotype METPO:1000059 pending a closer endocytic capability hierarchy. This is uptake by a microbe, not microbial induction of uptake by a host cell. Phagocytosis traitmech:000627 is particle engulfment, phagotrophy traitmech:000628 requires nutritional assimilation, and trogocytosis traitmech:000633 removes portions of living cells. These are neither equivalents nor disjoint organismal capabilities. Generic pinocytosis is broader; its existing phagocytosis discussion mention is not an exact unresolved macropinocytosis node. Membrane ruffling without closure, solute transport alone and uptake into small endocytic vesicles are insufficient. No fixed diameter cutoff, enhanced uptake rate, axenic growth or nutrition is required. No unverified synonym or process-level ontology xref is asserted.

items.prompt: This structure is reported by more than one MIBiG entry: BGC0000435, BGC0002518. Confirm they describe the same compound rather than an upstream cross-reference error.
Separate the secretion phenotype from its component steps.
items.rationale: This concerns secretion by the microbe, not a host-cell response. Docking, intracellular trafficking or fusion alone does not demonstrate cargo release. Transporter-mediated export, membrane budding, lysis, cell-cell fusion and endocytosis are not equivalents. Constitutive and stimulus-regulated secretion are included; total emptying, permanent vesicle collapse and a shared calcium response are not required. This hierarchy refinement does not narrow the executable detector, resolve the functional gaps, or reinterpret computational calls as measured antiviral phenotypes. A second direct parent, traitmech:000572 Lamassu type II system, now captures the LmuC component already required by this definition. The short-family parent is retained because component presence and LmuB-length family are separate axes. Neither hierarchy relation experimentally validates HNH antiviral activity or narrows the detector's broader scope.

attaches_to: ecological_interactions#Minimum Energy Threshold for Syntrophic Growth

items.prompt: Review shortening through disassembly without requiring complete disappearance.
items.rationale: This physiological phenotype concerns shortening of a previously assembled eukaryotic axoneme. Static short flagella, failed assembly, nonmotility, bending or coiling, passive breakage, or shedding a largely intact organelle alone do not establish it. Neither complete structural disappearance nor complete protein recycling is required. Basal severing and residual transition zones can accompany resorption; the class does not require an intact base or the absence of severing. Eukaryotic flagellar autotomy traitmech:000731 and bacterial polar flagellar ejection traitmech:000732 have different endpoints. Bacterial periplasmic resorption involves a different apparatus. No organism-level disjointness is asserted. Phenotype METPO:1000059 is the definition-based parent; locomotion is not required. Palmelloid formation traitmech:000654 does not require flagellar loss.

items.prompt: Distinguish array constituents, the nucleating subassembly and external ring context.

Mto1/Myp2 spatial offsets and dosage responses constrain simple direct coassembly without excluding indirect association. Unknown tubulin or center assembly essentiality is not replaced by a cell-viability phenotype. Ase1 deletion leaves an altered array, so this constituent is DISPENSABLE for assembly.

items.prompt: Resolve taxon-specific interactions and native proteins before graphing.

items.rationale: The bacterial flagellar motor is the membrane rotor plus stator torque generator. The rod, hook and filament transmit or receive the motor output, the LP rings act as envelope bushings, and the export apparatus secretes axial subunits, but they are outside the rotor/stator motor boundary.

items.prompt: Ground conditional examples and taxon-specific mechanisms before adding canonical taxa or a graph.

No shared universal molecular mechanism or taxon-paired protein branch is established here. Gene presence, lac-locus annotation, RpoS expression or predicted flux alone cannot establish observed diauxic growth. It is conditional on culture and nutrients, not a fixed species identity or sequence-feature trait. Qualified MED and Crossref metadata for all five sources exposed no linked correction or retraction at the 2026-10-11 check; available primary pages were also inspected. This bounded check does not guarantee absence of notices; Wang's preprint link is not a correction. Canonical examples, causal graphs and external equivalences remain unasserted rather than being inferred from these observations.

items.prompt: Retain lineage-level risk spreading without equating all cellular heterogeneity with bet hedging.
items.rationale: The diversifying qualifier restricts this class to alternative states within a clonal microbial lineage; it does not cover every use of unqualified bet hedging. Heterogeneity, noisy gene expression or switching alone is insufficient: reversible states must precede the relevant environmental shift and differ in survival or reproductive performance across conditions. Generic stress-induced change, carbon-source memory, cue-triggered environmental anticipation, genetic resistance and ecological generalist/specialist niche breadth are not exact synonyms. Particular observations can overlap without making these classes equivalent or disjoint. Dormancy and persister formation can participate in risk spreading, but their presence alone does not establish it, so neither existing record is reparented. METPO:1000059 phenotype is the conservative parent pending upstream review of this lineage-level physiological disposition. This is not a sequence feature, individual assay result or mixed-species community property. Following Levy et al. Box 1, the relevant state interconversion must be independent of the prevailing environment; temporal precedence alone does not establish this criterion. Cue-triggered preparation before a later change is not sufficient. Deterministic age-related variation can qualify, so environmental independence does not require a purely stochastic switching mechanism.

That residue is identical in 93% of 375 short bacterial homologs and sits at Pfam HMM match state 78, whose consensus residue is a highly conserved E with emission probability 0.602. The protein has no Walker A or Walker B motif. None of that is activity. The family is not uniformly catalytic, since three of four human paralogues assayed were inactive, so conservation of the glutamate cannot settle whether this protein is an enzyme, and no causal edge is curated for it. Resolving it needs an assay, not more sequence analysis.

Retain the source-specific replication and growth-inhibition limitations; resolve external equivalents and alternative labels before adding synonyms or xrefs. items.prompt: Resolve natural examples and mechanism breadth without inferring feeding from sequence.

Motility genes, secretion systems, hydrolases or other sequence features alone do not establish coordinated prey consumption. Direct nutrient assimilation and individual fitness benefits require evidence beyond the reported fluorescence-loss readout. These limits are not evidence that collective predation is absent.

items.prompt: Why did increasing riboflavin 13.22-fold from 0.276 uM (SO1-BS1) to 3.65 uM (SO2-BS1) capture most of the pre-IrrE leaching gain (50.7 to 64.1 mg L^-1; maximal rate 12.3 to 16.4 mg L^-1 day^-1) whereas a further 12.60-fold riboflavin increase in SO2-BS2 (46.00 uM) yielded only 69.6 mg L^-1 (maximal rate 16.2 mg L^-1 day^-1)?
items.rationale: PMID:42733304 showed that SO2-BS1 (3.65 uM riboflavin, 243.71 mW m^-2) already reached a maximal leaching rate of 16.4 mg L^-1 day^-1 (vs 16.2 mg L^-1 day^-1 in SO2-BS2 at 46.00 uM riboflavin) and experienced a sharp drop in average leaching rate from 9.867 mg L^-1 day^-1 (days 1-6) to 0.617 mg L^-1 day^-1 (days 7-14), indicating that once riboflavin reaches the micromolar range in SO2-BS1, accumulated Ni2+ and Co2+ cytotoxicity rather than electron-shuttle concentration becomes the primary rate-limiting bottleneck.

items.prompt: Review the shortening-defined parent without equating all contractility endpoints.
items.rationale: Require active reduction of cell-body length or the extension of a cytoplasmic projection. Generic force production or isometric contractility alone is insufficient. Extracellular pilus retraction, injection-system contraction, contractile-vacuole cycling and cytokinetic constriction alone do not establish this endpoint. Neither passive osmotic shrinkage, death-associated shortening nor static short-cell morphology suffices. The existing body and rapid axopodial traits are narrower children; stalk contraction traitmech:000730 is now a narrower child, defined by active reduction of stalk end-to-end extension. This does not require shortening of the stalk contour or make its sheath cytoplasm. Motility METPO:1000701 and motile METPO:1000702 concern locomotion, not necessarily shortening. Active denotes the cellular response, not demonstrated ATP-driven motor action. No universal speed, fractional shortening, trigger, calcium threshold, ATP dependence, ecological role, exact synonym for generic contractility or organism-level disjointness is asserted.
items.record_label: cell body or cytoplasmic projection contraction

Keep intracellular nuclear fusion distinct from broad self-fertility.
items.rationale: Use the unpaired-cell nuclear-fusion sense supported by the cited ciliate studies, not plant self-pollination or all selfing. The existing homothallism traitmech:000609, unisexual reproduction traitmech:000613 and primary homothallism traitmech:000614 definitions are explicitly fungal-scoped and are not exact parents or synonyms. Cytogamy traitmech:000623 involves paired cells without nuclear exchange in Nobili and Luporini p.39, unlike this unpaired-cell definition. Diller (1958), DOI:10.1111/j.1550-7408.1958.tb02567.x, uses double autogamy for the tentative paired-cell observation. That broader source terminology does not make cytogamy a child or exact synonym of this operationally unpaired-cell class. No universal genetic identity, complete homozygosity, starvation trigger, nuclear count, inability to outcross or gamete-size asymmetry is imposed. The parent gap is resolved by automixis traitmech:000625, whose single-meiotic-cell nuclear origin includes this operational scope. The broader terminology and mapping questions keep this discussion OPEN. Verify external equivalences and source-specific synonym scope before adding mappings. Paedogamy traitmech:000624 instead involves separate gametes formed within one gametangium. The clarified definition excludes their fusion, without forbidding later cell division or postmeiotic nuclear mitosis. These are event-level distinctions, not disjoint species.

Direct QuickGO authority checks resolve GO:0085035 haustorium as a cellular component and GO:0052094 formation of haustorium for nutrient acquisition as a biological process, not exact organism-level phenotypes. GO:0085041 arbuscule is an is_a child of GO:0085035, whereas literature often distinguishes arbuscules from parasitic haustoria. Preserve that attributed umbrella usage: the definition is not restricted to pathogenicity, but arbuscule formation is not asserted as an exact synonym or given a new hierarchy here. The GO membrane-invagination definition does not describe every tremelloid micropore interface. No xrefs or SSSOM equivalences are asserted. Parasitic-plant haustorial organs are outside this microbial hyphal scope; fungi and oomycetes are both included. Fungal arbuscule formation now has its own source-bounded phenotype record, traitmech:000664. This resolves the missing record reference, not the umbrella hierarchy question; no subclass or disjointness relationship between these two phenotypes is asserted.

items.prompt: Resolve an exact source-neutral grounding for the lipid constituent of the chloroplast thylakoid membrane.
items.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0009535 and UniProt SL-0058, but the lipid bilayer constituent is intentionally left as a reviewed-label-only component until an exact source-neutral lipid or membrane-constituent CURIE is curated.

items.prompt: Retain sequential nutrient use without imposing a universal lag or regulatory mechanism.
items.rationale: Boulineau's Introduction defines sequential carbon use, while lag-emphasizing accounts operationalize a narrower growth-curve pattern. Wang reports short or nonexistent lags; Sandercock and Page extend the observed scope to nitrogen-source transitions. The present definition uses the nutrient-switching sense and does not require glucose preference, a positive minimum lag, complete arrest of every cell or strictly zero secondary-substrate use. An arbitrary biphasic growth curve without nutrient-switching evidence is insufficient. Diauxic shift denotes the transition; polyauxie and unqualified diphasic growth are not exact synonyms. METPO:1000731 nutrient adaptation is a trophic-type class whose local record operationalizes chronic copiotroph/oligotroph nutrient regimes, not this temporal pattern. Phenotype is the conservative parent pending upstream hierarchy review. Generalist and specialist denote niche breadth; dormancy, carbon catabolite repression and generic resource-use predicates are not exact equivalents.

items.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral identifiers for fungal vacuole V-ATPase, transporter, acid-hydrolase, and membrane-trafficking machinery cohorts, or split these groups into narrower grounded complexes and families.

This first record captures the genome-level possession trait without claiming exact molecular groundings for heterogeneous integrases, relaxases, T4SS variants, Actinomycete ICE machinery, or adaptive cargo phenotypes.

items.prompt: Resolve DS-21 native host breadth, exact profile-to-protein mapping, HHpred-domain interpretation, component chemistry, complete phage breadth, molecular output, and rule-level DefenseFinder criteria before minting narrower DS-21 mechanism children.

The pinned DefenseFinder HMM inventory records three DS-21 custom profile rows. The pinned rules table has no DS-21 row, and the first-pass record does not resolve native host breadth, complete phage breadth, direct profile-to-protein correspondence, PDDEXK nuclease activity, molecular output, or endogenous DS-21 activity.

items.prompt: This structure is reported by more than one MIBiG entry: BGC0002409, BGC0002410. Confirm they describe the same compound rather than an upstream cross-reference error.
Keep Hrs1 downregulation and meiotic transition phenotypes source-bounded.
items.rationale: Hrs1 degradation and phosphorylation jointly downregulate the radial organizing system near meiosis I. Stabilized nonphosphorylatable Hrs1 can delay bipolar spindle formation; this is not a universal complete block, and outcomes depend on temperature and the spindle checkpoint. Phosphomimetic effects do not prove that every identified phosphorylation has the same native role. Ectopic Hrs1 produces HAA-like arrays in vegetative cells but does not turn every such cell into a native meiotic HAA exemplar. The later spindle is not the HAA, and disappearance of array signal is not direct proof that every tubulin subunit is degraded.

items.prompt: Resolve Shedu sensor classes and DNA substrate preferences before minting narrower Shedu subtype or mechanism children.

items.prompt: Resolve the molecular basis of quiescent bundle stabilization.

The paper does not identify a quiescence-specific capper or establish a GTP-depletion mechanism. FRAP, drug and cold resistance bound stability to the measured assays rather than proving zero turnover indefinitely.

items.prompt: Distinguish degradation from broader glycophagy usage.
items.rationale: The explicit degradative endpoint narrows autophagy traitmech:000638 without changing that parent's identity. This is intracellular cargo recycling, not growth on glycogen, extracellular amylolysis, granule possession or a gene inventory. The Cells paper introduces glycophagy as selective but reports nonselective K. phaffii turnover; the iScience paper also uses glycophagy for vacuolar preservation during sporulation. Those source-attributed usages are not exact synonyms of this endpoint-defined record. GO:0061723 was directly resolved at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/ontology/go/terms/GO%3A0061723 as a nonobsolete biological process for selective glycogen degradation by macroautophagy. It is narrower on selectivity and route, and is not an exact organismal phenotype. Omit exact xrefs and synonyms. Broader delivery/storage and selective subtype relationships require human review, not silent normalization of conflicting terminology.

items.prompt: Retain oxygen-sufficient overflow as a conditional phenotype with an explicit hierarchy boundary.

Neither that process nor METPO:1000060 metabolism is adopted as an is-a parent of this organismal phenotype. METPO:1000059 phenotype is used pending upstream hierarchy review. Product-specific ethanol/butanediol fermentation, aerotolerance, facultative anaerobiosis, copiotrophy and diauxic growth are not equivalent. Product detection or oxygen presence alone is insufficient: oxygen limitation must be excluded. No universal substrate, product, concentration, growth-rate threshold, complete respiratory shutdown or fixed molecular mechanism is required.

Separate assembly, recruitment, activity and maintenance phenotypes.

Review update 2026-10-11: direct inspection of the 2006 equatorial Results and Figure 5C-E confirms residual equatorial assembly in mia1-deletion cells. Alp7 assembly essentiality is therefore now DISPENSABLE under the tested S. pombe conditions, superseding its earlier UNKNOWN classification; sustained nucleation-site use remains defective. The other unresolved essentiality values, including Rsp1 UNKNOWN, are unchanged.

items.prompt: Resolve natural examples and source-bounded mechanisms before extension.

Keep genotype, filamentation, spore germination, meiotic segregation and subsequent mating ability separate. The two studies report different self-fertility outcomes for progeny carrying compatible homeodomain determinants; retain strain background and copy-number context rather than generalize sterility. Inspect unread figures, supplements and source sections before more detailed claims or quantitative rates. Resolve native protein accessions and experimentally tested dependencies before causal edges; no NONMECHANISTIC graph bypasses grounding. Manual full-text snippet matches remain distinct from the abstract resolver's actual verdicts.

items.prompt: Add strain-matched UniProtKB protein_examples for Escherichia coli K-12 alpha-galactosidase MelA (UniProtKB:P06720) so alpha_galactosidase_hydrolysis_sketch can be promoted from NONMECHANISTIC to MECHANISTIC.
items.rationale: The record's primary literature (EC 3.2.1.22, DOI:10.3109/07388551.2013.794124, DOI:10.1128/jcm.22.3.333-335.1985) establishes alpha-galactosidase hydrolysis of alpha-1,6-linked galactose residues in oligosaccharides and galactomannan and positive alpha-galactosidase activity in Selenomonas sputigena (NCBITaxon:69823), but a strain-matched canonical example and verified UniProtKB accession on a GENE_OR_PROTEIN node must be curated before marking the graph MECHANISTIC.

items.prompt: Resolve type-II effector diversity and LmuC function without conflating axes.
items.rationale: Type II classifies LmuC-containing Lamassu architecture, not an isolated LmuC hit, a fixed three-gene count, a long-LmuB clade, or a universal LmuC-dependence phenotype. The effector module can include more than one gene. Existing HNH, SMEK and Hydrolase-Protease definitions require LmuC and therefore fall below this class; HNH also retains its short-family parent. This is a definition-based hierarchy inference, not new experimental validation of those children. Legacy detector-defined effector records and the complete long/short families are not reparented merely from model labels or optional LmuC calls. The V. cholerae nuclease mechanism does not establish chemistry for every effector module. Native-host activity, protein accessions and broader mechanistic generalization remain unresolved; no causal mechanism graph is asserted. Type I remains a separate discovery lead. items.rationale: GO places the microsporidian endospore and exospore as parts of spore wall, but those layers are specific to microsporidian spores. Fungal ascospore layers remain under GO:0005619 ascospore wall and bacterial endospore layers remain under GO:0043591 endospore external encapsulating structure.

items.prompt: Keep the SIN/MEN two-component GAP complex distinct from the broad SIN/MEN signaling complex and from SPB-localized SIN activation states.
items.rationale: GO:1990334 denotes the narrower two-component GAP that inhibits Tem1/Spg1 GTPase signaling and is part of the spindle pole body. It is not equivalent to the broader GO:0160065 SIN/MEN signaling complex, nor to the GO:0160066 old-SPB interphase or GO:0160067 new-SPB anaphase SIN states.

items.prompt: Keep the conventional intraconoid microtubules distinct from the unusual ribbon-like tubulin fibers that form the conoid.
items.rationale: Hu et al. distinguished the two intraconoid microtubules from the conoid fibers, whose tubulin protofilaments form a ribbon polymer rather than a closed microtubule tube. This record therefore curates only the two conventional intraconoid microtubules.

items.prompt: Distinguish the verified NA1000 example from species-wide prevalence.
items.rationale: A species-level VARIABLE presence row would imply patchiness across lineages that the curated NA1000 experiments do not establish. A qualifying note cannot remove that assertion from the structured field.

items.prompt: Verify B80 protein identity and keep remote-homology candidates separate from assays.
items.rationale: A Pfam-linked publication is not enough to map a purified activity to the family when peptide/reference and coordinate inconsistencies remain. Remote homology and HExxH alone do not establish directed causation.

items.prompt: Resolve the ancient-domain mechanism separately from RWD-driven Yih1 phenotypes.
items.rationale: PF01205 maps to C-terminal residues 144-251 despite the frozen Impact_N name. Three whole-protein phenotypes do not establish this domain's isolated mechanism.

items.prompt: Which carbon-transfer and redox mechanisms determine the staged coculture solvent profile?

items.prompt: A pocket score cannot assign positive modulation. Measure the direction of the relevant activity or affinity change under stated ligand/assay conditions; an R-state model is not a universal requirement.

No producer claim is written from BGC0002129, which gives NCBITaxon:77133 (uncultured bacterium — shared by every unplaced bacterium), because the taxon names no single organism. The cluster is kept: a characterized locus is an origin assertion whether or not its host has a name, and for a compound from an uncultured symbiont that is the honest state. Name the producer if the primary literature does.
Resolve Aditi phage triggers and effector outputs before minting narrower Aditi mechanism children.
items.rationale: Millman et al. and DefenseFinder support Aditi as a named anti-phage system with DitA and DitB profiles, but the trigger, molecular substrate, antiviral effector output, and subtype-specific mechanism are not resolved enough here to assert a narrower mechanistic child trait.

items.prompt: Keep the named inner-density subassembly distinct from the cartwheel hub and its proteins.
items.rationale: A density-defined cellular subassembly is not a protein assignment, and the CID abbreviation has been used at two levels of granularity.

items.prompt: Keep mating-type contribution distinct from selfing, helper cells and MAT inventory.
items.rationale: One mating type does not mean one strain: non-isogenic same-type partners can exchange genetic material. Solo selfing overlaps homothallism (traitmech:000609), but the whole class is not restricted to single-isolate self-fertility. It is not a subclass of parasexuality (traitmech:000607), because meiotic cycles are also included. Pheromone-producing opposite-type helper cells are not necessarily genetic contributors, so do not require their physical absence. Use released phenotype METPO:1000059 in both record and proposal; PHYSIOLOGY is only a filesystem category. MAT sequence content, population mating-type bias or hyphae alone do not establish reproductive completion. Do not require universal meiosis, spores, cell fusion, clonality or absence of outcrossing. Resolve context-dependent same-sex mating terminology and external phenotype/process mappings before adding synonyms or xrefs. The existing homothallism evidence note, citing DOI:10.5598/imafungus.2015.06.01.13, groups unisexual reproduction within a homothallism umbrella. That wording conflicts with interpreting the current single-isolate self-fertility definition as a universal superclass here. Our scope decision interprets the umbrella as including unisexual selfing, not as evidence that every same-type outcrossing partner is independently self-fertile. Preserve the older source attribution and retain phenotype while the operational and umbrella scopes await curator reconciliation; issue #1703 records this explicit distinction.

items.prompt: Avoid making clustering the unique cause of every mutant phenotype.

items.rationale: The record is exactly grounded to GO:0030668, but no dense-granule-specific lipid or lipid-bilayer CURIE was curated for the membrane constituent.

items.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral DnaA and Dps family groundings for the DnaA-Dps complex.
items.rationale: GO:1990084 names DnaA and Dps as the E. coli constituents of the DnaA-Dps complex. Exact source-neutral InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family CURIEs need narrower curation before these components can be grounded.

items.prompt: Resolve an exact external ontology class for citrate fermentation before adding a TraitRecord xref.
items.rationale: No exact GO or external metabolism class was resolved for anaerobic citrate fermentation; generic citrate metabolic process terms, citrate lyase or transporter molecular functions, and citrate-test assay terms are shifted relative to this pathway-scoped fermentation class.

items.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral family groundings for the CAF-1 p90, p60 and p50 constituent classes.
items.rationale: The budding-yeast CAF-1 subunits correspond to broader eukaryotic p150, p60 and p48 subunit classes; exact InterPro, Pfam, NCBIfam or UniProt family CURIEs should only be curated after verifying that they denote the subunit class rather than a WD40 or acidic-domain motif.

items.prompt: Review a reproductive phenotype parent and qualified mappings.
items.rationale: Retain phenotype METPO:1000059. Sporulation METPO:1000870 and spore forming METPO:1000871 concern endospores, whereas mycelial growth traitmech:000074 concerns bacterial hyphae. The four obsolete METPO conidium/conidia classes denote material entities, not an active organismal phenotype. PMID:9199700 documents bacterial conidium usage, so the fungal qualifier is intentional. Synnema formation traitmech:000656 is stalk aggregation and includes sporeless forms; neither trait is imposed as the other's is-a parent. Pseudohyphal growth traitmech:000653 is a cell arrangement, not equivalent to conidial production. Leave exact synonyms and xrefs unset pending authority and scope review; process ontology classes need not be exact organismal phenotypes.

items.prompt: Resolve Rst_DUF4238 native host breadth, accession-level DUF4238 proteins, and the molecular mechanism of T7 restriction before minting narrower Rst_DUF4238 mechanism children.

This first system-level record leaves native host breadth, accession-level component grounding, the profile-to-activity mapping, and the T7 restriction mechanism unresolved.

items.prompt: Resolve exact source-neutral groundings and finer component boundaries for Giardia ventral-disc lateral-crest proteins.

items.prompt: Which selective mechanisms explain the measured community responses?

The retained composition-to-degradation mechanism is PARTIAL because composition and substrate accessibility change together. Do not confuse failure to degrade most BSM O-glycans with failure to degrade its N-glycans, or A.muciniphila abundance with demonstrated sialic-acid utilization. items.prompt: Resolve TIR-VII native host breadth, the TIR-VII__TIR-VII_A and TIR-VII__TIR-VII_B profile-to-component mapping, phage-trigger specificity, TIR-domain output chemistry, and rule-level DefenseFinder detection criteria before minting narrower TIR-VII mechanism children.

The pinned DefenseFinder HMM inventory records TIR-VII__TIR-VII_A and TIR-VII__TIR-VII_B custom profile rows, but the pinned DefenseFinder rules table has no TIR-VII row. This first record therefore does not assert profile requirement logic, accession-level components, a direct phage trigger, or TIR-domain output chemistry.

items.prompt: Resolve borderline loci and long-family activation mechanisms.
items.rationale: Long denotes a phylogenetic and structural family, not an isolated protein, a fixed amino-acid threshold, an effector name, or the component-number type II category. A raw long-profile hit alone does not settle membership of an ambiguous locus. The published detection sheet uses gene_name for actual hits and hit_gene_ref for potentially exchangeable model slots; these fields must not be conflated. Hydrolase-Protease spans both length families; the legacy FMO record's detector-defined scope and SMEK's long-profile exception need separate reconciliation before reparenting. No universal effector chemistry, LmuC requirement, zinc-hook count, or stoichiometry is imposed. The experimentally resolved short Vc-Cap4 activation mechanism is not transferred to this family. Native-host activity, accession-level protein anchors and family-wide activation remain open, so no causal mechanism graph is asserted.

items.prompt: Resolve Divona phage triggers and effector outputs before minting narrower Divona mechanism children.
items.rationale: Darracq et al. and DefenseFinder support Divona as a named anti-phage system with a VCA0374 profile, but the trigger, molecular substrate, antiviral effector output, and subtype-specific mechanism are not resolved enough here to assert a narrower mechanistic child trait.

items.prompt: Resolve CapRel trigger breadth, phage escape routes, and family-specific activation before minting narrower CapRel mechanism children.
items.rationale: Zhang et al. support CapRelSJ46 sensing of a major capsid protein and an unrelated Gp54 trigger, but fused CapRel homologs need separate review before TraitMech asserts one universal phage trigger, CapRel escape route, tRNA target spectrum, or phage specificity across the family.

items.prompt: Separate mantle morphogenesis from bulk expression and perturbation effects.
items.rationale: A protein-resolved causal graph is deferred pending authority-verified proteins, sequence-to-culture links and inspection of the relevant perturbation images, not because mechanisms are absent. DOI:10.1128/AEM.01991-15 reports a thicker mantle in native ald1 overexpression; it does not establish an obligatory universal pathway. Its mte1 evidence is heterologous yeast growth rescue, not a native mantle-formation knockout. Keep increased thickness, first sheath formation, branching and plant responses separate. DOI:10.3390/microorganisms9122612 uses an EcM transcriptomic sample containing all fungal and mixed plant-fungal material within 0.5 cm of a root. Coexpression in that bulk sample is not mantle-specific localization or functional validation. The paper explicitly presents working models for future experimental tests.

items.prompt: Resolve a live, audit-clean UniProt protein example for a taxon-specific photoferrotrophy branch.

attaches_to: ecological_interactions#Proposed Cyanobacterial Polymer Use by Verrucomicrobiota
items.prompt: Which genomic niches and reciprocal services operate in this alkaline consortium?

The nutrient-return to vitamin-production arrow has no supporting experiment. Figure 3 explicitly depicts inference from gene content; Figure 4 supports carbon flow, not compound-resolved flux or a trophic cascade. Bacteroidota remains a genuine member with inferred metabolic niches, not proven nutrient-return function. Stability over years does not mean fixed membership or experimentally established redundancy mediation. Additional niche and MAG-resolved graph coverage remains issue #1699 pending scoped Edison report; no unsupported edge is added to give every taxon connectivity credit.

items.prompt: Is the stressosome indispensable for environmental stress sensing?
items.rationale: Not in every tested context. The 2025 PY79 experiments retain ethanol and salt responses after core loss. A clean rsbRA-rsbS deletion also depresses RsbT production, so its failure to signal cannot by itself establish core necessity. Translation-stop constructs address this confound. The study does not rule out sensory functions for individual RsbR paralogs.

items.prompt: Model the Trypanosoma reservosome as a separate downstream organelle rather than as an early-endosome subtype.
items.rationale: Porto-Carreiro et al. 2000 placed the early endosomal network upstream of posterior reservosome storage in T. cruzi epimastigotes, so this record keeps the generic GO:0005769 early-endosome identity distinct from the minted reservosome record.

items.prompt: Which MSC-1 dependencies explain persistence and conditional coculture growth?
items.rationale: Retain three observations and zero arrows, preserving the earlier workflow-edge deletion. Early total OD on supplied soluble NAG is not partner-resolved benefit or late-phase improvement. Soil-network centrality from pooled relative abundance is not causal interaction or keystone necessity. Canonical participants are explicitly incomplete, and the source Table 1 maps the Rhizobium isolate to Rhizomicrobium OTU68; no new taxon equivalence is asserted. Storage drift, 31-versus-35 OTUs, Sect_C_4-versus-C2 naming, herbicide dose and inconsistent positive/negative Methods inequalities need separate reconciliation under #1569. Whole fresh primary body and main text table read; figure pixels, separate supplements and raw data not audited.

items.prompt: Which strain-resolved antagonism belongs alongside the separate Transwell demonstrations?
items.rationale: The two demonstrations remain separate. The roster now names the Cv017/Cv026 reporter pair and the Table 1 wild-type SC11,378/ATCC 31532, E264 and DC3000 members of the three-member series. Current NCBI names and PMID:33159606 support C. subtsugae for the ATCC 31532 lineage; source C. violaceum terminology is retained in evidence and notes. SC11,368 in Results versus SC11,378 in Table 1 is not resolved; use the table-defined identity provisionally, not as independent experimental-stock verification. No new antagonism node or downstream arrow is added. Lower P. syringae live-cell counts with B. thailandensis do not selectively establish bactobolin mediation. New structure requires the separate Edison extension workflow; no provider job or spend occurred in this correction. Issue #1467 remains open and the graph remains needs_research. Cultivation metadata still conflates test tubes with Transwell plates and distinct assay media; these preserved fields are not certified. Main scientific bodies, Table 1 and captions read, not independent figure images, separate supplements or raw spectra.

items.prompt: Which exact-system measurements distinguish the observed outcome from the proposed mechanism?

Nitrosospira and Nitrobacter declined in aerobic abundance and mapped RNA; Nitrobacter nitrogen-gene RNA was not detected, and other populations could contribute. items.prompt: Should CommunityMech represent time-resolved composition, or keep trajectories in linked datasets and carry only the qualitative dynamic claim as an interaction?
items.rationale:
The curated finding here is a trajectory — P. aeruginosa falls and A. baumannii rises over 10 days — but TaxonomicComposition carries a single abundance per member with no time axis, so `abundance_level` had to be set to the phage-free baseline and the trajectory written into interaction descriptions instead. A consumer reading abundances alone sees P. aeruginosa DOMINANT and A. baumannii RARE, which is the pre-phage state and the opposite of this record's point.
What would resolve it is a decision about whether CommunityMech represents time-series composition at all, or deliberately keeps trajectories in linked datasets and carries only the qualitative dynamic claim in `ecological_interactions`. This record is a good test case either way: the underlying per-timepoint densities are published.

items.prompt: Preserve reversible and irreversible switching without equating it with self-fertility.
items.rationale: This is a fungal switching capability, not a literal MAT locus, HO gene, donor cassette, direct repeat or static sequence feature. A mating-type change within a cell or developing lineage is distinct from ordinary segregation of mating types among sexual progeny. Resolve cellular, nuclear and colony-level assay scope before assigning the trait to an organism. Switching can contribute to homothallism but is not identical to it; a switched nucleus need not make the whole colony uniformly another mating type. Homothallism, heterothallism, ploidy, heterokaryosis and parasexuality are not is-a parents. PHYSIOLOGY is a filesystem category. Do not require reversibility, one cassette architecture or a universal cell-cycle stage. Resolve external phenotype/process mappings and the scope of mating-type alteration or interconversion before adding exact synonyms or xrefs.

Resolve unifactorial terminology and external equivalences before adding synonyms or xrefs. PHYSIOLOGY is a filesystem category, not a narrower ontology parent.

items.prompt: Refine the infection-strategy hierarchy without conflating infection, trapping and feeding.

The host-contacting or ingested spore is the infectious unit; spore germination into an external hyphal trap is not this route. Adhesion or ingestion alone, killing alone, internal occupancy without the specified route and sequence annotation are insufficient. Vermiform stages distinguish the selected strategy from eggshell penetration in fungal nematode egg parasitism traitmech:000726. Fungal nematophagy traitmech:000719 requires feeding and includes dead prey; fungal nematode trap formation traitmech:000718 concerns hyphal differentiation. Neither is asserted as a parent. Local parasitism traitmech:000043 inherits persistent symbiosis, not required here. Animal pathogen METPO:1004002 is active below pathogenic to host METPO:1004000 and phenotype METPO:1000059. Current upstream clarifies its pinned organism-like wording as a phenotype; the local parent remains unchanged. No organism-level disjointness, exclusive host stage, universal host range or obligacy is asserted. Bare endoparasitism does not specify the fungal actor, host or infection route and is not an exact synonym.

This component-based refinement neither resolves the long-profile exception nor restricts the trait to short Lamassu, and does not confer experimental validation on the computational calls.

items.prompt: Keep postfusion incompatibility distinct from broader vegetative barriers.
items.rationale: This organismal phenotype is not a het/vic locus, protein domain, sequence feature or individual pairing result. It requires nonself recognition, not merely slow growth or cell death. Barrage formation, prefusion avoidance, negative autotropism, sexual incompatibility and inability to fuse are not exact equivalents. Hyphal anastomosis can precede this response and is not an is-a parent. The definition does not require death of the whole colony, failure of every nonself pairing or a single conserved death pathway. The 2006 vic4 result prevents treating vegetative incompatibility as an unqualified exact synonym. Resolve organismal ontology equivalences at their issuing authorities before adding xrefs.

items.prompt: Which host responses and microbial functions causally mediate SynCom protection?

They do not report selective immune/barrier blockade or rescue, direct barrier permeability or barrier-protein validation. Elevated DAO is ambiguous, and the IgA phrase is a pathway annotation. Main text reports non-antagonistic in vitro co-culture and preliminary single/pair/triple feeding comparisons; supplementary images/data were not inspected. In-host cross-feeding and signaling remain hypotheses. items.prompt: Keep liquid propulsion distinct from surface movement and passive displacement.
items.rationale: Motile METPO:1000702 is the broader energy-dependent locomotion phenotype. Swimming concerns propulsion through liquid, including near a boundary, not locomotion across a supporting substrate. Swarming traitmech:000062, twitching traitmech:000061 and gliding METPO:1000706 are not exact synonyms. Passive advection, settling, Brownian motion, colony growth and appendage possession alone are insufficient. Neither a particular speed, solitary behavior, chemotaxis nor a specified propulsion apparatus is required. Bacterial flagella and archaeal archaella must not be conflated. An organism can exhibit swimming and surface motility in different conditions; no organism-level disjointness is asserted. Existing flagellar-motility process nodes, swimming-velocity capacities and taxis discussions are not exact ungrounded instances of this trait. Upstream METPO issue 271 requests this gap; it does not supply an accepted identifier. External phenotype equivalences and lexical variants remain unasserted pending authority checks.

items.prompt: Which nutritional interactions mediate the diet-dependent mouse-gut evenness endpoint?
items.rationale: Keep unequal supernatant rescue distinct from community growth. The Bayesian model used in-vitro qPCR time series with inoculum perturbations; its net interaction edges do not identify molecular flux or prove an all-to-all mutualistic network. items.prompt: Preserve enhanced reactivation after repression as the defining endpoint.
items.rationale: Compare induced transcript responses under matched later test conditions and genetic backgrounds, after intervening repression. Continued expression, transcript or reporter persistence, a chromatin mark, peripheral localization or a gene alone does not establish this phenotype. Transcript abundance does not by itself distinguish synthesis from degradation. No identical first and second stimulus, prior production of a particular transcript, fixed duration, universal mitotic inheritance or shared chromatin mechanism is required. Carbon-source memory (traitmech:000706) spans growth and induction endpoints and is not reparented wholesale. Memory of acquired stress resistance (traitmech:000712) concerns retained resistance, not faster transcription. Anticipation and bet hedging are also not exact equivalents. Unqualified transcriptional memory, epigenetic memory and priming are not asserted as exact synonyms. METPO:1000059 phenotype is the conservative parent pending hierarchy review; existing records are unchanged.
